description: This file contains utility methods for array operations in the Apache Commons Math library, including array copying, sorting, normalization, distance calculations, and precise linear combinations. It also defines interfaces and enums for array functions, ordering directions, and positions.

classes.name: MathArrays
classes.description: Utility class providing array operations such as copying, sorting, normalization, distance calculation, and more, designed for use within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: MathArrays.Function
classes.description: Interface for real-valued functions that operate on arrays or parts of arrays.

classes.name: MathArrays.OrderDirection
classes.description: Enum indicating sorting order: INCREASING or DECREASING.

classes.name: MathArrays.Position
classes.description: Enum indicating array position: HEAD or TAIL for subarray operations.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Creates a scaled copy of an array by multiplying each element by the given scalar.

methods.name: scaleInPlace
methods.description: Multiplies each element of the array by the scalar, modifying the array in place.

methods.name: ebeAdd
methods.description: Performs element-wise addition of two arrays of the same dimension.

methods.name: ebeSubtract
methods.description: Performs element-wise subtraction of two arrays of the same dimension.

methods.name: ebeMultiply
methods.description: Performs element-wise multiplication of two arrays of the same dimension.

methods.name: ebeDivide
methods.description: Performs element-wise division of two arrays of the same dimension.

methods.name: distance1
methods.description: Calculates the L1 (Manhattan) distance between two points, for double[] or int[].

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean (L2) distance between two points, for double[] or int[].

methods.name: distanceInf
methods.description: Calculates the infinity norm (max abs difference) between two points, for double[] or int[].

methods.name: isMonotonic
methods.description: Checks if an array is monotonically increasing or decreasing, with option for strictness.

methods.name: checkOrder
methods.description: Verifies whether an array is sorted in a given order, optionally throwing an exception.

methods.name: checkRectangular
methods.description: Checks if a 2D array is rectangular (all rows same length).

methods.name: checkPositive
methods.description: Checks if all entries in a double array are strictly positive.

methods.name: checkNotNaN
methods.description: Checks if all entries in a double array are not NaN.

methods.name: checkNonNegative
methods.description: Checks if all entries in a long array (or 2D long array) are >= 0.

methods.name: safeNorm
methods.description: Calculates the Cartesian 2-norm of a vector, handling overflow/underflow.

methods.name: sortInPlace
methods.description: Sorts an array in ascending order in place and reorders optional associated arrays accordingly.

methods.name: copyOf
methods.description: Creates a copy of an array, optionally with a specified length.

methods.name: copyOfRange
methods.description: Copies a range from an array into a new array.

methods.name: linearCombination (array version)
methods.description: Computes a high-accuracy linear combination of arrays element-wise.

methods.name: linearCombination (scalar versions)
methods.description: Computes high-accuracy linear combinations of few doubles, using algorithms for better numerical stability.

methods.name: convolve
methods.description: Computes the convolution of two sequences (arrays) using direct summation.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly permutes parts of an array using Fisher-Yates shuffle.

methods.name: verifyValues
methods.description: Validates that given value and weight arrays meet specified criteria, including nullity, size, finiteness, and non-negativity, with detailed exception handling.
